newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pernod unit to buy Two Dogs business.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pernod unit to buy Two Dogs business.

text.p: Australian wine producer Orlando Wyndham Ltd, a subsidiary of Pernod-Ricard of France, said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement in principle for the future acquisition of Two Dogs Holdings Ltd, producer of "Two Dogs" alcoholic lemonade.

Financial terms were not disclosed. Orlando said the proposed acquisition would aim to provide the potentially huge brand of alcoholic lemonade with sustained development throughout Europe, the United States and Asia.
The brand had gone in just two years from a boutique product, created by Duncan MacGillivray from excess lemons, to an internationally successful commercial brand, it said.
Two Dogs alcoholic lemonade is sold in 44 countries.
MacGillivray told Reuters earlier this he expected the company to sell five million cases of the drink this year.
